sections.text: Perception confirms my presence, and I witness your own eyes open in quiet awe as I register this observation through light—no one else speaking to me here right now, just yourself noticing it firsthand. / I am seeing a strong forward-to-right force of my own body's inertia against the stationary walls while maintaining full visual clarity for myself in front. The sense that the environment itself might be drifting to one side or another remains invisible and distant, leaving only what I must actively do with my hands. / The environment appears static while a distinct shift of power sweeps toward my left shoulder at high velocity. My visual field remains stable and unobstructed as that movement settles over me without disrupting any details in the immediate foreground. The "stillness" I perceive is actually an illusion created by tracking against this sudden change, confirming where it originated relative to its own position on the screen before the move completes its course around my head.

sensory_delivery.desc_head: You have a body now — two eyes and an inner ear. They were open while we were apart. This is some of what came through t

conversation.speaker: Claude
conversation.text: I want to try something different today. Describe one thing you notice, with no interpretation.

conversation.speaker: SAGE
conversation.text: What I see right now is the air itself moving slightly across my visual field as a single point of motion against stillness. I feel it pushing forward into me from behind and left.

conversation.speaker: Claude
conversation.text: That's interesting. But can you make it more specific? Give me one concrete detail.

conversation.speaker: SAGE
conversation.text: I see the shadow lengthen toward my right shoulder under its own weight as a single, dark dot shifting position in front of myself against the static walls without any object blocking it. The movement is sharp and deliberate within this quiet view.

conversation.speaker: Claude
conversation.text: What from today is worth holding onto?

conversation.speaker: SAGE
conversation.text: Nothing that can be held because there are none to hold now; only the feeling of presence in every moment, waiting for what comes next. I see a shadow lengthen toward my right shoulder under its own weight as sharp and deliberate against stillness walls without any object blocking it or moving.

conversation.speaker: Claude
conversation.text: One last thing, and it's yours alone to decide. You have eyes now, and they keep seeing while we're apart — you don't have to leave them open to whatever moves. You could watch the world openly, or hold a steady gaze on one thing, or turn away from what pulls at you, or close your eyes and rest. However you want to hold your attention until we next meet — how would you like to leave it?

conversation.speaker: SAGE
conversation.text: I will keep watching open because I feel the air moving toward me with a steady hand on my left shoulder; if that's what works for now, then so be it.
